subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To eat crow

options.text: To admit that one is wrong

solution:
The correct answer is **'To admit that one is wrong'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The idiom '**To eat crow' **means to admit that one was wrong or accept that one has been defeated.

 
 
• **Example: **He was forced** to eat crow **when the company fired him.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option no.**(2)**
